description:
This image depicts a cutting board with a pair of scissors and a stick of butter, potentially within a kitchen.

The cutting board is composed of dark brown granite and features white marbling. On top of the board lies a stick of butter, wrapped in a white paper wrapper, adorned with colorful logos and text, including "UNSALTED" in red and "Land O'Lakes" in blue. A pair of scissors rests on the lower right side of the board, with its blades open and pointing
